title: agentlake / ops
description: Hot-path operational view over agentlake.trace_events_rt (ADR-005). Counts use uniqExact(span_id) so they are exact regardless of merge state; sums tolerate a transient over-count bounded by the measured duplicate window. Time-picker driven throughout.

panels.title: Spans
panels.description: uniqExact(span_id), not count(): the Kafka engine is at-least-once, so a row count can transiently over-report. Distinct span ids cannot.

targets.rawSql: SELECT uniqExact(span_id) AS spans FROM agentlake.trace_events_rt WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(ts)

panels.title: Error rate
panels.description: status != 'ok', not status = 'error': status is a free-form contract string and the SDK promotes any set(status=...) value.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100.0 * uniqExactIf(span_id, status != 'ok') / greatest(uniqExact(span_id), 1) AS error_rate_pct FROM agentlake.trace_events_rt WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(ts)

panels.title: Cost
panels.description: A sum, so this is the metric that tolerates a transient over-count after a consumer rebalance. See ADR-005 #2.

targets.rawSql: SELECT sum(cost_usd) AS cost_usd FROM agentlake.trace_events_rt WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(ts)

panels.title: p95 LLM latency
panels.description: The aggregate ADR-004 #6 could not produce: Flink 1.20 has no percentile function, so percentiles land here.

targets.rawSql: SELECT quantile(0.95)(latency_ms) AS p95_ms FROM agentlake.trace_events_rt WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(ts) AND event_type = 'LLM_CALL'

panels.title: Request rate by event type
panels.description: Spans per minute. The bucket is the panel's auto interval, so the rate is normalised by $__interval_s rather than reported per bucket.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval_ms(ts) AS time, event_type, uniqExact(span_id) * 60.0 / $__interval_s AS spans_per_min FROM agentlake.trace_events_rt WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(ts) GROUP BY time, event_type ORDER BY time

SELECT $__timeInterval_ms(ts) AS time, quantile(0.5)(latency_ms) AS p50, quantile(0.95)(latency_ms) AS p95, quantile(0.99)(latency_ms) AS p99 FROM agentlake.trace_events_rt WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(ts) AND event_type = 'LLM_CALL' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT $__timeInterval_ms(ts) AS time, 100.0 * uniqExactIf(span_id, status != 'ok') / greatest(uniqExact(span_id), 1) AS error_rate_pct FROM agentlake.trace_events_rt WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(ts) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Tokens per minute by model
panels.description: prompt + completion. model IS NOT NULL drops the RETRIEVAL/TOOL_CALL/AGENT_STEP rows, whose NULL model is real data rather than a defect (ADR-004 verification log).

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval_ms(ts) AS time, model, (sum(prompt_tokens) + sum(completion_tokens)) * 60.0 / $__interval_s AS tokens_per_min FROM agentlake.trace_events_rt WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(ts) AND model IS NOT NULL GROUP BY time, model ORDER BY time
SELECT $__timeInterval_ms(ts) AS time, model, sum(cost_usd) AS cost_usd FROM agentlake.trace_events_rt WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(ts) AND model IS NOT NULL GROUP BY time, model ORDER BY time

panels.title: Retrieval latency p50 / p95
panels.description: RETRIEVAL spans from services/rag. Worth watching for the observer effect ADR-003 #6 records: an unwarmed embedding model puts the first call at ~7s against ~1s after.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeInterval_ms(ts) AS time, quantile(0.5)(latency_ms) AS p50, quantile(0.95)(latency_ms) AS p95 FROM agentlake.trace_events_rt WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(ts) AND event_type = 'RETRIEVAL' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT $__timeInterval_ms(ts) AS time, 100.0 * uniqExactIf(span_id, status != 'ok') / greatest(uniqExact(span_id), 1) AS tool_error_rate_pct FROM agentlake.trace_events_rt WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(ts) AND event_type = 'TOOL_CALL' GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Cost per session
panels.description: session_id is the SDK's cross-turn key (ADR-000 #1) and the topic's partition key; trace_id is one turn. So turns here is the number of turns in the session.

targets.rawSql: SELECT session_id, sum(cost_usd) AS cost_usd, uniqExact(trace_id) AS turns, uniqExact(span_id) AS spans FROM agentlake.trace_events_rt WHERE $__timeFilter_ms(ts) GROUP BY session_id ORDER BY cost_usd DESC LIMIT 20
